question: Does the number of real components of the normalized cubic root curve bound the global cover pool more sharply?
inputs: The same six equation-only root-curve inputs as the completed Frobenius test. No points, class anchors or rank labels.
method: Isolate real roots of rad(discriminant)*B by exact rational intervals. Read the merging root pair from the sign of B. At an ordinary split I2 node, connect crossing normalization branches instead of merging them; at a nonsplit node remove the isolated real node. Glue the ordered real roots around RP1, including the degree-four x transition at infinity. Count connected components of the resulting graph.
endpoint: For normalized genus g and s real components, dim Jac(C)[2](R)=g+s-1. Compare this with the prior generic pool bound only after the topology computation.
failure: UNKNOWN on timeout or unsupported fibre configuration. No numerical component guesses and no extension of the cap.
